newsitem.title: USA: Abaco Grupo Q4 shr loss narrows.
newsitem.headline: Abaco Grupo Q4 shr loss narrows.

text.p: Abaco Grupo Financiero said Friday that results for the fourth quarter and full year show operations improved in the final quarter.
For the fourth quarter, the company said, a loss of $26.1 million pesoswas registered, compared with a loss of $458.8 million pesosin the fourth quarter of 1995.
For the full year, a net loss of $455.5 million pesoswas reported, which compares with a net loss of $472.9 million pesos for the year 1995, the company said.

"Considering Abaco's efforts in expense reductions and operating efficiencies, targeting management, personnel, operations and publicity costs, together with the development of new products and strategic alliances, we foresee a continuing positive trend," the company said.
